# cloudendure_machine (Data Source)

Looks up a source machine in the CloudEndure project by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudendure_machine" "web" {
  name = "web-01"
}

output "web_replication_status" {
  value = data.cloudendure_machine.web.replication_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Machine ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Source machine name (hostname). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set. Must be unique in the project.

### Read-Only

- `is_agent_installed` (Boolean) Whether the CloudEndure agent is installed on the machine.
- `machine_cloud_id` (String) ID of the source machine in its cloud, if any.
- `os` (String) Source machine operating system.
- `replica` (String) ID of the most recently launched target machine, if any.
- `replication_status` (String) Replication status, e.g. `STARTED`, `PAUSED`, `STOPPED`.
